title: Join pieces of text
summary: PHP: Join pieces of text. Add an exclamation mark with another dot.
introduction: The dot joins text in PHP. Joining is called concatenation. Read the example, then check the result.
learningObjectives: Join pieces of text with PHP
Add an exclamation mark with another dot

blocks.text: Install PHP 8.2 or later. Save each example as lesson.php and run php lesson.php. These are local programs, not a server for this learning site.
The dot joins Hi, and Ravi. The space comes from the first string, not from the operator.
Add an exclamation mark with another dot.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Use a dot to join text; plus is for numbers.
